description: Source code for QuicSimpleServerStream class implementing HTTP/QUIC stream handling, including request processing, response generation, error handling, and integration with backend and transport mechanisms.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerStream
classes.description: Implements a QUIC stream handling HTTP/QUIC requests, responses, error handling, and backend interactions.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of initial headers, validates headers, and processes CONNECT requests.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Processes available request body data, manages content length validation, and triggers response or connection handling.

methods.name: HandleRequestConnectData
methods.description: Handles data received in a CONNECT request, passing it to the backend.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Generates and sends a response based on request headers and backend data.

methods.name: connection_id
methods.description: Returns the connection ID associated with the stream.

methods.name: stream_id
methods.description: Returns the stream ID.

methods.name: peer_host
methods.description: Returns the peer host address as a string.

methods.name: GetStream
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current stream object.

methods.name: OnResponseBackendComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of backend response, including delays and special response types.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends a response, including early hints, error responses, or generated bytes.

methods.name: SendStreamData
methods.description: Sends data on the stream, optionally closing it.

methods.name: TerminateStreamWithError
methods.description: Terminates the stream with a specified error.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Handles writable event, triggers writing of generated bytes.

methods.name: WriteGeneratedBytes
methods.description: Writes generated bytes in chunks until the specified length is reached.

methods.name: SendNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Sends a 404 not found response.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends a 500 error response.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Overloaded; sends an error response with specified code.

methods.name: SendIncompleteResponse
methods.description: Sends a partial response with headers and body, possibly without fin.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBody
methods.description: Sends headers and body as a complete response.

methods.name: SendHeadersAndBodyAndTrailers
methods.description: Sends headers, body, and trailers, managing fin flags appropriately.

methods.name: IsConnectRequest
methods.description: Checks if the request method is CONNECT.

methods.name: OnInvalidHeaders
methods.description: Handles invalid headers by sending a 400 error.
